OpenBareMap England & Wales 2.0 — Garmin revision r2
Updated 1 November 2026

This revision corrects the large blue-area display problem and avoids conflicts with the separate My Tracks map.

1. Copy OpenBareMap-England-Wales.img into the Garmin folder on your device or memory card, replacing the previous file with the same name. Keep backups outside the Garmin folder, so an old England & Wales map is not loaded alongside the replacement.
2. Safely eject the device, disconnect it and restart. Enable OpenBareMap England & Wales in the device's map settings if necessary.
3. Set elevation units to metres. The map uses 20-metre contours.

Ireland and personal-track map files do not need changing. This is a display-only map without turn-by-turn routing.
